Hybrid Aquatic Wiki.text: A wiki of all there is to find in the Minecraft mod Hybrid Aquatic

Yellowfin Tuna.text: Yellowfin Tuna are medium-sized passive fish that spawn in all Ocean biomes.

Great White Shark.text: Great white sharks are large, predatory fish that spawn in oceans, deep oceans, cold oceans, and deep cold oceans.

Tiger Shark.text: Tiger sharks are large, predatory fish that spawn in oceans, warm oceans, and lukewarm oceans.

Whale Shark.text: Whale sharks are large, passive fish that spawn in oceans, warm oceans, and lukewarm oceans.

Basking Shark.text: Basking sharks are large, passive fish that spawn in oceans, warm oceans, and lukewarm oceans.

Thresher Shark.text: Thresher sharks are medium, predatory fish that spawn in warm oceans, lukewarm oceans, and deep oceans.

Bull Shark.text: Great white sharks are large, predatory fish that spawn in oceans, warm oceans, lukewarm oceans. They can also be rarely spotted in rivers and mangrove swamps.

Hammerhead Shark.text: Hammerhead sharks are large, predatory fish that spawn in oceans, warm oceans, and lukewarm oceans.

Frilled Shark.text: Frilled sharks are medium, predatory fish that spawn in deep oceans and deep cold oceans.

Plushies.text: To obtain a plushie, the wandering trader has a chance to offer a variety of plushies for sale, each with an opportunity to be available. Look at the selection and discover the adorable plushies that might be on offer.
